6.6-Liter V8 Power

The 2022 Express 2500 is equipped with Chevrolet's 6.6-liter V8 gasoline engine, a purpose-built powerplant that produces around 401 horsepower and 464 lb-ft of torque. Rear-Wheel Drive Capability

Purpose-Built Cargo Space

As a Regular Van 3D cargo configuration, the Express 2500 prioritizes usable interior volume over passenger comfort — and that's exactly the point. For buyers who want a newer model year with modern safety and efficiency features without paying new-vehicle prices, this is a smart entry point into ProMaster ownership.2025 RAM ProMaster Performance and Engine

3.6L Pentastar V6 with 9-Speed Automatic

Under the hood sits RAM's proven 3.6-liter Pentastar V6 engine with Variable Valve Timing, paired to a smooth 9-speed automatic transmission. This combination delivers a confident balance of torque for loaded hauling and reasonable fuel efficiency for high-mileage route driving. The front-wheel-drive layout — unique in the full-size cargo van segment — places the engine weight over the drive wheels, which means better traction on wet pavement and improved handling in tight urban environments like downtown Bakersfield or crowded warehouse districts.

The low floor height that FWD makes possible also translates directly into easier loading, less physical strain on workers, and more usable cargo volume than many rear-wheel-drive competitors.RAM ProMaster Features and InteriorThe Tradesman trim is purpose-built for professional use. Expect durable, easy-clean surfaces, available cargo bulkhead separation, and the kind of stripped-down, practical layout that fleet managers love. The high-roof configuration on the 2500 gives standing room inside the cargo area — a huge advantage for technicians, delivery professionals, or anyone building out a mobile workshop. The 159-inch wheelbase stretches the load floor to accommodate standard pallets, long materials, and custom shelving systems with room to spare.RAM ProMaster Reliability and Ownership

What ProMaster Owners Can Expect

The RAM ProMaster has earned a reputation as a dependable commercial van when properly maintained. The Pentastar 3.6L V6 is one of Chrysler's most widely used and well-understood engines, with a strong service network and widely available parts throughout Bakersfield and the greater Kern County area. Good credit, challenged credit, or first-time commercial buyers — reach out and let them find a solution that fits.Frequently Asked Questions

Is the 2025 RAM ProMaster 2500 a good buy?

Yes. The ProMaster 2500 High Roof with the 159-inch wheelbase offers class-competitive cargo volume, a proven powertrain, and the practical advantages of front-wheel drive. For tradespeople and delivery operators, it's one of the most cost-effective full-size cargo vans on the market.

A well-maintained ProMaster with the Pentastar V6 can reliably reach 150,000 to 200,000 miles or more. At 61,267 miles, this van is in solid shape for continued commercial use with proper upkeep.

The Tradesman is the workhorse trim — focused on durability and utility. It typically includes vinyl flooring, a steel bulkhead option, basic infotainment, and a configuration ready for commercial upfitting or shelving systems.

Why does the RAM ProMaster use front-wheel drive?

The ProMaster's FWD layout comes from its European Fiat Ducato roots. It allows a lower floor height, improved traction in slippery conditions, and a simpler drivetrain with less maintenance overhead — advantages that fleet operators genuinely appreciate in daily use.

Is the high-roof 159-inch wheelbase ProMaster good for upfitting?

Absolutely. Now, with Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again. Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, your ultimate co-pilot.
  • Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.
Safety and Security
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
